svg.title: Retained relative-error and total-gate trajectories for five AutoVQE examples
svg.desc: Lines show the retained checkpoint after each candidate evaluation. Filled circles are kept candidates, and series-colored open diamonds are first retained crossings of the ten to the minus four target. For each problem, labels mark the three retained updates with the largest relative-error reduction versus the preceding retained checkpoint. The lower panel shows each retained total-gate count as a percentage of that problem's maximum retained gate count on the same evaluation-step axis.

svg.text: Text labels show each problem's three largest accepted relative-error reductions; open diamonds mark the first 10⁻⁴ crossing. The shaded 10⁻⁴–10⁻¹⁰ range is compressed into one log interval.
